environment.machine: AWS i8g.4xlarge, Graviton4 (16 Neoverse V2 cores), Amazon Linux 2023, glibc 2.34
environment.profile: release bench profile, default target features (outline atomics)

graviton4.protocol: planner_arena heap arm; base and candidate built in separate target directories; three alternating runs per tree; per-workload median of the three divan medians; base spread is the slowest base run over the fastest. Both trees use the branch head's helix-ast-bench.

revisions.before: 7e7c9e15 docs: record the switch to simd-json and what it costs
revisions.after: c6878dd4 perf(planner): digest each memo expression once

per_change_one_thread.description: Executable DAG state indexed by dense step position
Catalog lookups through borrowed key views
OptimizerConfig borrows the catalog and stats
Seed optimizer built once per process
Contradiction analysis keyed by borrowed property names
Pipeline parts moved instead of cloned per step
Binary digests (JSON kept for physical tie-breaks) and indexed return bindings
Shared projection property lists
Conjunction branches extended in place
Planner context scoped once per batch
Physical tie-break digests computed only on cost ties
Diagnostics step state indexed by position
Struct fields digested by position
Literal equality branches grouped by sorting
Borrowed pruning and validation without building plans
Wide set subsumption pre-filtered by digest
Memo expressions digested once

rejected_one_thread.description: Binary digests for physical tie-breaks too: changed the plan chosen between equal-cost alternatives for 100 reviewed Cypher queries
foldhash for the catalog maps: no effect

shared_names_and_arena_ceiling.note: Measured on 7e7c9e15 (before) and 7ac71ad2 (after: shared Arc<str> names and the map-free contradiction check). heap is mimalloc; arena serves every planning allocation from a per-thread bump region; plan_clone clones the finished plan. _t16 fields ran on 16 threads.

lse.note: before/after as above; lse_ fields were built with -C target-feature=+lse, which inlines atomics instead of calling the outline-atomics helpers.

graviton4_after_merge.note: Per-change A/Bs after merging main, as in graviton4.per_change_one_thread. "build" says how both sides were built: release, or with the dist profile settings (thin LTO, one codegen unit). build_profiles compare the same source built with release settings (base) and with the named settings (candidate).

per_change_one_thread.description: Per-run index rewrite cache
Memoizer compares against the memo copy
Cache lookups skip known predicate digests
Source predicates moved into their plans
SelectionProgram expression and slot set behind one Arc
